SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name, MAX(ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit, MAX(sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss, MAX(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM (
    SELECT 
        ss.ss_item_sk, 
        ss.ss_store_sk, 
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        cs.cs_net_profit
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN store_returns AS sr 
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk 
        AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk 
        AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
    JOIN catalog_sales AS cs 
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk 
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim AS d1 
        ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim AS d2 
        ON d2.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim AS d3 
        ON d3.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    WHERE d1.d_moy = 4 AND d1.d_year = 1999
    AND d2.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d2.d_year = 1999
    AND d3.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d3.d_year = 1999
) AS filtered
JOIN store ON store.s_store_sk = filtered.ss_store_sk
JOIN item ON item.i_item_sk = filtered.ss_item_sk
GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
ORDER BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
LIMIT 100
